Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring draft registration for a driver's license.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to compliance with federal selective servicerequirements before the issuance of a driver's license; adding a newsection to chapter 46.20 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person who applies for an original, renewal, or replacementinstruction permit, intermediate driver's license, driver's license, oridenticard, and who is less than twentysix years of age, and isrequired to do so, must be registered in compliance with therequirements of section 3 of the Military Selective Service Act, 50U.S.C. app. 451 et seq., as amended. (2) The department shall forward in an electronic format thenecessary personal information of an applicant identified in subsection(1) of this section to the selective service system within ten days ofthe completion of the application. The applicant's submission of theapplication serves as an indication that the applicant either hasalready registered with the selective service system or that he isauthorizing the department to forward to the selective service system p. 1 HB 2428the necessary information for the registration. The department shallnotify the applicant at the time of application that his submission ofthe application will serve as his consent to registration with theselective service system, if so required. The department shall alsonotify the applicant that if he is under the age of eighteen he will beregistered upon turning age eighteen as required by federal law. (3) The department may adopt rules necessary for the implementationof this section.
